cmd.name: German chamber
cmd.description: Allows enchantresses to gain experience by learning from more experienced warriors
cmd.param: NamePlr, Ritual sagrado, default, NameSet, Ritual sagrado, default

cmd.name: Control
cmd.description: Las hechiceras pierden casi toda su salud al invocar animales, evitando su muerte si no estan previamente heridas
cmd.param: ReqSet, Ritual sagrado, default, NamePlr, Control, default

cmd.name: German Wolf Summoning
cmd.description: Allows enchantresses to sacrifice themselves and summon a wolf, which is under your control for about 3 minutes
cmd.param: ReqSet, Ritual sagrado, default, NamePlr, Wolf Summoning, default

cmd.name: German Eagle Summoning
cmd.description: Allows enchantresses to sacrifice themselves and summon an eagle, which is under your control for about 2 minutes
cmd.param: ReqSet, Ritual sagrado, default, NamePlr, Eagle Summoning, default

cmd.name: German Bear Summoning
cmd.description: Permite a las hechiceras sacrificar su vida para invocar un oso.
cmd.param: ReqSet, Ritual sagrado, default, NamePlr, Invocar oso, default

cmd.name: German Mass Heal
cmd.description: Allows enchantresses to sacrifice themselves to heal nearby allies
cmd.param: ReqSet, Ritual sagrado, default, NamePlr, Mass Heal, default

cmd.name: Amuleto de los caidos
cmd.description: Todos los nuevos guerreros estan equipados con un amuleto de los caidos, que aumenta los puntos de rango que pueden ganar en combate.
cmd.param: ReqPlr, Ritual sagrado, default, NameSet, Amuleto de los caidos, default, SetsSet, items/Amuleto de los caidos, 1

cmd.name: Alucinogenos
cmd.description: Permite reclutar berserkers en el cuartel
cmd.param: ReqPlr, Ritual sagrado, default, NameSet, Alucinogenos, ,default, NameSet, NVAEL,

cmd.name: Furia salvaje
cmd.description: Permite a los berserkers entrar en trance furioso, haciendo que ataquen descontroladamente a cualquier unidad cercana hasta morir
cmd.param: ReqSet, Alucinogenos, , NamePlr, Furia salvaje, default
